scope: Profile3 counterpart of the transition CREATE corpus in its runtime-oracle role (plan u2c4-design.md section 4, regeneration item 2): the same 72 cases (46 positive, 26 negative) produced by the unchanged version2 phase code with serializer3.load() as the only change. Input generation only: no product or recovery execution before the single current-format switch commit.
writer_rules: Import only the SHA-pinned serializer3 (stdlib; it checks its own version2 parent pin). Call load(), then its profile(), canonical_cases(profile) and mutants(cases) exactly once each. Never call its disabled emit/main or row_job; histories are Catalog scope2 only.

emit is a copy of the version2 emit with only the output directory, generator id and status text changed: same 37-field cases.tsv order, raw-index.tsv, manifest.json; create-new writes after every bound check.
Write-once: refuse if raw/, manifest.json or generation-result.json exists. Preserve any failed output; no silent regeneration.
auditor_rules: Separate stdlib parser; does not import the generator or serializer3.
Verify raw inventory, hashes, sizes and the 72/46/26 counts; every raw blob hash equals its file name.
Every Root cell (XQR1) in a raw page is version3 with row_high@432 = 0 and bytes 440..512 zero; every Job cell (XQJ1) is version3 with kind != 3; the profile blob is the Profile3 ID1 literal.

Schedule equivalence with the frozen version2 cases.tsv: id, expected, operation, LSN, ordinal, plan scalars (fields 0..16), page-role order (field 22) and the presence pattern of every hash field are equal; frame lengths are equal; every positive frame differs from version2.

Cross-corpus identity: every native3 step in epoch 1 whose pure_reference names a transition case has the same frame hash as this corpus's case; the set of native3 steps with equal frames equals the version2 native/transition equal set (later epochs re-seal the outer XWF epoch, as in version2).
